notes.en: Static content review only. SKILL.md, bundled pure-stdlib scripts (search_databases.py, verify_citations.py, lit_verify.py), fixtures and license notices reviewed against the manifest: declared capabilities execution.remote/network/workspace.read/workspace.write and required tool exec.shell match shipped content; the optional --online citation mode is the only guest network egress and stays under the declared network capability and task policy, with offline verification the default. No self-granted trust, no unlisted-skill fetch, no install-time privilege. Guest execution remains UNPROVEN (Main-owned); this is not runtime qualification or App acceptance.
